chunks: Say to those who disbelieve: if they desist, what has already happened will be forgiven them; and if they return, then the custom of the former [people] has already passed.

key_terms.سُنَّةَ الْأَوَّلِينَ: the custom/fate of the former nations

ai.seo_question: What is the choice offered to the disbelievers in Surah Al-Anfal regarding their past sins and future fate?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as offering a conditional reprieve to the Quraysh, emphasizing that divine forgiveness is contingent upon genuine cessation of hostility. It underscores the concept of 'Sunnah Allah' (God's established way), illustrating that persistent rejection of truth leads to inevitable destruction, mirroring the fate of earlier nations like Thamud and 'Ad. This serves as both a warning to the disbelievers and a reassurance to the believers of God's consistent justice.
